newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end flat, shrug off rate rise, Nomura.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end flat, shrug off rate rise, Nomura.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended mostly steady on Wednesday after see-sawing throughout most of the session. Brokers said the market reacted little to the Fed's rate rise as it had already been factored into the market, and Nomura Securities recovered slightly after falling on news of a raid.
The 225-share Nikkei average ended 32.84 points or 0.18 percent higher at 18,472.45. Its June futures were unchanged at 18,440.
"Buying was slow to emerge for the shares investors sold off after collecting dividends," Yasuo Ueki, Nikko Securities general manager, said.
